findings.summary: The committed scientific runner requires environment.path, while the frozen execution-contract schema, reference runner, and oracle runner require environment.record_path; an authorized scientific run must fail before environment-graph verification.

The committed scientific runner requires BYTE_IDENTICAL_CANONICAL_COMMON_PAYLOAD, while the execution contract and both mechanics runners require BYTE_IDENTICAL_CANONICAL_CERTIFICATE_PAYLOAD; the scientific authority guard cannot accept the frozen contract.

The oracle and scientific runners do not verify the exact reviewed_inputs and reviewer_independence contents required for every stage review; the scientific runner also does not require empty findings.

The contract hash-DAG node spot-checks top-level counts and hashes but omits exact nested-schema, Commit-1/2 parent-subject-extent, inherited Git-object, review-content, runtime, terminal, agreement, production, and prospective CONTRACT3 assertions.
